summary: 周日较安静。dapplion 发布 EIP-8390 移除同步委员会的 Magicians 讨论帖，`SYNC_REWARD_WEIGHT` 移除且不重新分配。账户侧有一份新 ERC，执行委托框架，即 ERC-8391。hasufl 回顾比特币区块大小之争，认为活动迁往其他链的主因是可编程性而非区块大小。

items.title_en: Magicians: EIP-8390 remove the sync committee
items.note_en: 16:30 (dapplion). It removes the sync committee, its aggregate, subnets, domains and rewards, and the Altair light client protocol built on it; `SYNC_REWARD_WEIGHT` is removed and not redistributed.

keywords_en: looking back at the block size wars
summary_en: A quiet Sunday. dapplion posted the Magicians thread for EIP-8390, removing the sync committee, with `SYNC_REWARD_WEIGHT` removed and not redistributed. On accounts there was one new ERC, an execution delegation framework, ERC-8391. hasufl looked back at Bitcoin's block size wars and argued that activity moved to other chains mainly because of programmability, not block size.
